description: Election Commission - R. Pradeep Kumar was Selected as the member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member (Rathini Pradeepkumar) by a recognized political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. The content is specifically about electoral processes for a local authority, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
